Measurement error is 0.03 mag, with an additional 0.12 mag systematic. Internal RGB extinction is assumed negligible. The result is 0.50 mag larger than the earlier TRGB estimate.

Preliminary JWST result using a method-matched unweighted Sobel calibration from NGC4258. A secondary edge lies about 0.1 mag fainter, but artificial-star bias is below 0.01 mag.

Alternative s=0.10 mag smoothing selects the fainter Sobel peak and raises mu_0 by 0.15 mag. Add sigma_var=0.07 mag; the 0.032 mag maser uncertainty is excluded.
